camera.shot_scale_bias: loose mediums walked alongside the subject through real streets
camera.height: eye level, handheld, carried at walking pace

lighting.practicals: bare daylight, uncorrected, sometimes blown out

palette.grade: grainy monochrome feel, printed a stop light

rules: the subject may glance at the lens and get away with it
composition.movement_of_subject: people walk, smoke and talk over each other, unposed

sound.ambience_bias: street noise recorded with the picture: heels, traffic, cafe clatter

music.instrumentation: A jazz trio of piano, brushes and upright bass
music.dynamics: dropping out abruptly and returning mid-phrase

must_include: the camera walks with the subject through a real location

notes: Rules are for other people's films.
